name: X Files
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: X Files turns replies to your X posts into a drainable Omarchy queue, not another feed. The bar shows work and API spend; open the panel to group questions, gripes, and asks, keep quotes and inspect digests with volume, velocity, and bucket counts. A hard monthly cap stops new X API reads. It reads only your posts, mentions, and reply conversations; never posts, DMs, reads your timeline, or scores sentiment. Credentials stay in a private 0600 file; PII-redacted BYOK summaries are off by default.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify only when a new reply enters the needs-your-reply queue.

schema.label: Monthly spend cap (US dollars)
schema.description: A hard stop, not a warning. At the cap the poller stops fetching until the month rolls over.

schema.label: Cost per post read (US dollars)
schema.description: The X API post-read rate. Adjust down if your account bills owned reads cheaper; the spend meter uses this to charge every returned post.

schema.label: Spend meter display
schema.description: How loudly the API spend shows. Compact: a small fill bar, no dollar figure. Full: the exact amount and projection. On alert: hidden until you near the cap. Off: never shown. The hard-stop cap and its banner work in every mode; the exact amount is always on the pill tooltip.
